capabilities: Generate a filelist file of wikilinks for each configured folder
Regenerate all filelists from a ribbon icon
Sort listed files by modification time, newest first
Exclude file extensions and filenames from filelists
Configure a root-level filelist for the vault root with a '/' path
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to keep an index file of the files inside a given folder.
summary: A filelist generator that creates Markdown files of wikilinks to every file in folders you specify.
